touches.text: Skills (skills/: cairnhelp, challenge, chart, commit, intent, sorted, ...) are Claude Code's. The deterministic parts move out of markdown into CC device verbs: a skill's OS-side work runs as a script, and CC's shim processes the result and injects it into the session. WHY: every habit captured that way is one CC no longer spends inference on, so CC gets faster; a first charting pass done in deterministic Python with no LLM until after saved about 90% of tokens, measured in real use.
